title: An evaluation of LLMs for generating movie reviews: GPT-4o, Gemini-2.0 and DeepSeek-V3

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the sentiment polarity and emotion distribution (e.g., joy, sadness, disgust) of LLM-generated movie reviews compared to human-written IMDb reviews to identify tendencies to amplify, skew, or overrepresent certain emotional responses.
